intent_en: To illustrate Dubai's economic transition from a near-total reliance on the pearl industry to a diversified economy following the discovery of oil, highlighting the lesson of not depending on a single resource.
previous_intent: To illustrate Dubai's economic diversification from a pearl-dependent industry to oil and infrastructure development following the discovery of oil in 1966.
narration_support: never rely on just one resource
chart_support: Pie chart with a UAE flag showing a large dominant segment (representing the historical dominance of the pearl industry) flanked by a blue shell with a wrench (symbolizing industrial development/infrastructure) and a pink shell with a pearl (symbolizing the pearl industry)
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the lesson 'never rely on just one resource' after the pearl industry crash (95% of economy). The chart visualizes this with a pie chart dominated by one color (likely the 95% pearl share) and icons representing the old pearl economy and new industrial development (wrench).
